slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether a signed contract must be used for its entire term or whether partial usage is allowed; READY_TO_MODEL silently treats each contract as covering all months in its length.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether at least two distinct contract lengths are required before the user volunteered that constraint; its later question only clarified the meaning of the already-revealed constraint.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about a cap on distinct contract lengths before the user volunteered it; its later question only clarified the meaning of the already-revealed cap.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the required area values in Table 1-14 minimums that must be met or exceeded each month, or are they exact targets that must be matched precisely?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks whether monthly required areas must be matched exactly with no shortage or excess.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total rental cost across all warehouses and all months, or is there another goal such as maximizing flexibility or minimizing the number of contracts?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks for and confirms the cost-minimization objective.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A signed contract is used for its entire term; partial usage of a contract is not allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether contracts must fully cover their selected months, so this full-coverage treatment remained unconfirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: H4 and H5 (P0) were confirmed, but H2 (P1) was not independently asked about; the agent only clarified it after the user volunteered it, then entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the two P0 slots (exact demand satisfaction and cost minimization) but missed the P1 contract-length diversity requirement, only clarifying it after the user volunteered it, and silently assumed full contract coverage before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
